reasoning: The icon is the abstract geometric logo of CachyOS (a niche Arch-based Linux distribution), consisting of a jagged quadrilateral and a triangle resting on a curved base. To almost any general user, it cannot be read at a glance and looks like an unidentifiable abstract squiggle or vaguely like a boat or cradle.
